correctness.rationale: The exact marginal and joint summations condition on record values. Conditional on the prefix maximum, past and future record indicators are independent. Reverse-hazard monotonicity makes the conditional current-record probability nondecreasing while future-record probability is strictly decreasing. Two-point exclusion and a three-point epsilon asymptotic prove exact minimum support. 84 independently enumerated rational cases, 2170 monotone-hazard cases, 30 positive witnesses passed. No finite check is used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: Classical independence of continuous iid record indicators fails under digitization. The theorem identifies a natural reliability/ordinal-tail structural sufficient condition for strict negative dependence at all pairs, but proves the opposite sign can occur even for iid observations, with the sharp minimum support three. This provides a genuinely informative boundary for finite-resolution record-event inference.
